description: Post a live screen card for the computer you're using into the chat, so the person can watch it and take control. Use it when the person asks to see, show or look at their screen or to connect to it; give a one-line caption. Needs the live device session you hold (session_id) and its computer (device_id). Do not post one on every task.

caption.description: One line, at most 200 characters. May be empty.

chat_id.description: Optional: defaults to the current chat.

device_id.description: The computer that session is on (UUID).

session_id.description: The live device session you hold (UUID).

name: show_screen
